title: Acute Comfort and Blur of Systane and Optive
brief_summary: To evaluate drop comfort, acceptability, preference and blur profile between two marketed artificial tears in both dry eye and non-dry eye patient population.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy, normal eyes OR documented diagnosis of dry eye

Exclusion Criteria:

* Must not have worn contact lenses for 7 days preceding enrollment
